generations.name: combat-first-pass
generations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Deliver a transparent eight-pose combat atlas for Arena Criolla.
Image1 is the approved ORIGINAL DOCTOR KNOCHE IDENTITY MASTER. Preserve EXACTLY that person's face, body proportions, costume, ink illustration and colors. Image2 is the real historical portrait, supporting facial likeness. The character is a lean mature man, NOT an elderly wizard: high forehead and full crown of short swept-back brown-grey hair, long nearly straight nose, serious deep-set eyes, strong dark moustache and compact pointed chin beard, shorter beard along jaw, no glasses. Keep this specific face at a natural adult 7.25-head body ratio in EVERY frame, never increase head size.
Same historical dark charcoal-brown wool jacket ending upper/mid-thigh, broad lapels, dark subtly patterned buttoned waistcoat, small pocket-watch chain, ivory high-collared shirt, broad dark bowtie, matching straight trousers, ordinary formal dark leather shoes. A tiny capped green glass vial sits tucked in one lower waistcoat pocket, attached to the body; same placement on the same side in every pose. Do not invent an adventurer utility belt, satchel, purple trenchcoat, long white beard, bald head, labcoat, spectacles or weapons.
Exactly EIGHT COMPLETE SEPARATE full-body figures, spaced in a FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid on a LANDSCAPE canvas. Genuine transparent RGBA empty space, at least 7% padding per figure, complete heads/hands/shoes, no overlaps. Same anatomical scale across all figures, even when crouched or airborne.
Top row, left to right:
0 READY: face/body look SCREEN RIGHT, athletic guard, knees slightly bent, two fists chest high, same pose and identity as master.
1 BLOCK: face looks RIGHT, both forearms raised tightly to protect head and chest, planted stance, clearly different silhouette from ready.
2 RUN A: runs RIGHT, LEFT knee/foot visibly FORWARD toward right, RIGHT leg extended BACK toward left; RIGHT forearm/fist forward and LEFT arm back.
3 RUN B: runs RIGHT in the OPPOSITE contact phase: RIGHT knee/foot visibly FORWARD toward right, LEFT leg BACK toward left; LEFT forearm/fist forward, RIGHT arm back. Arms AND legs MUST alternate compared with pose2. Not two copies of one run step.
Bottom row, left to right:
4 JUMP: compact airborne tuck, BOTH knees raised and feet off the ground, eyes/nose still face RIGHT. Same head/body scale, not a smaller person.
5 PUNCH: full straight horizontal punch toward RIGHT, extended punching arm and visible fist, opposite fist guards face, stable planted feet and torso rotation.
6 HIGH KICK: one leg kicks fully out toward RIGHT at chest/head height, entire foot visible, other leg supports his weight, fists near head. Not a running step or jump.
7 HURT: recoils AWAY FROM an opponent on the right, head/chest lean BACK TOWARD LEFT relative to hips, hands open and knees buckle. Face/nose still oriented RIGHT toward opponent, not looking left. No gore.
Hand-inked semi-realistic 2D arcade illustration with crisp contours and controlled cel shading matching image1. Preserve the facial proportions and historical attire. Every pose must be unique, believable anatomy with two arms and two legs. No extra character/portrait, no caption/text/labels/gridlines/watermark, no floor/shadows/background/glow/floating particles.
generations.reason: Two running poses had nearly identical stretched-stride silhouettes; frame3 required a distinct passing phase.
